sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LITTLE FLUCTUATION WILL OCCUR WITH THE LARGE SCALE PATTERN INTO WEDNESDAY...AS AN UPPER RIDGE /AND ASSOCIATED HOT AIRMASS/ WILL REMAIN CENTERED OVER THE SOUTH-CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TODAY. A BELT OF MODERATELY STRONG/LOW AMPLITUDE WESTERLIES WILL EXIST ACROSS THE CONUS NORTHERN TIER FROM THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST TO THE GREAT LAKES REGION...WITH SPLIT/BROADLY CYCLONIC UPPER FLOW PREVALENT OVER THE EASTERN QUARTER OF THE CONUS.

sections.title: SOUTHEAST STATES/SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS/CAROLINAS
sections.text: IT SEEMS LIKELY AN MCS WILL BE ONGOING EARLY TODAY ACROSS THE SOUTHEAST STATES INCLUDING PORTIONS OF AL/GA AND PERHAPS NORTH FL. IT IS NOT ENTIRELY CLEAR TO WHAT DEGREE STORMS WILL BE STRONG/SEVERE EARLY IN THE PERIOD...BUT BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING ESPECIALLY ON THE SOUTHERN/EASTERN FRINGE OF THE EARLY DAY MCS AND ASSOCIATED CLOUD CANOPY/OUTFLOW WILL AID SUSTENANCE/REINTENSIFICATION INTO THIS AFTERNOON. STORM ORGANIZATION WILL BE AIDED BY A CONTINUED GRADUAL INCREASE OF MID-HIGH TROPOSPHERIC FLOW...WITH A SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD PROPAGATION OF STORMS LIKELY TOWARD COASTAL AREAS. OTHER POTENTIALLY STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS THE TN VALLEY AND SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS VICINITY AS THE AIRMASS RECOVERS/DESTABILIZES. OVERALL...DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD...WITH SOME HAIL POSSIBLE AS WELL.

sections.title: DAKOTAS/NORTHERN MN
sections.text: WHILE LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE MODEST SOUTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER FOR MUCH OF THE PERIOD...AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTMS MAY DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON AS A HOT AIRMASS WILL EXIST IN VICINITY OF SURFACE TROUGH ACROSS THE WESTERN DAKOTAS. ADDITIONALLY...OTHER POTENTIALLY ORGANIZED STORMS COULD CROSS THE BORDER INTO ND/NORTHERN MN THIS EVENING/OVERNIGHT AS A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAX EMERGES FROM THE CANADIAN ROCKIES. GIVEN THIS OVERALL SCENARIO...MODERATE AMOUNTS OF BUOYANCY/VERTICAL SHEAR SUGGEST SEVERE HAIL/WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS.

sections.title: OH VALLEY/MIDWEST/LOWER GREAT LAKES
sections.text: ISOLATED/WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DIURNALLY DEVELOP/INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ALONG/AHEAD OF A SOUTHEASTWARD-MOVING COLD FRONT...OR MORE LIKELY...NEAR/SOUTH OF OUTFLOW ASSOCIATED WITH AN ONGOING EARLY DAY MCS. SUCH A DEVELOPMENT/INTENSIFICATION SCENARIO SEEMS MOST PROBABLE ACROSS PORTIONS OF DOWNSTATE INDIANA AND OH TO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES VICINITY. GIVEN THAT THE PRIMARY WAVE ALOFT WILL BE OVER SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF ONTARIO/QUEBEC...MAIN FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE LOWER GREAT LAKES WILL COINCIDE WITH MORE MODEST DESTABILIZATION...WHILE MASS CONVERGENCE MAY BE WEAKER/CAPPING STRONGER WHERE GREATER POTENTIAL INSTABILITY EXISTS ACROSS THE LOWER OH VALLEY. REGARDLESS...WHERE STORMS DO DEVELOP/INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING...BOUTS OF SEVERE HAIL/WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE. PORTIONS OF INDIANA/OH/NORTHERN KY/WV INTO WESTERN PA COULD ULTIMATELY WARRANT A CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK PENDING A GREATER CONFIDENCE IN SEVERE TSTM COVERAGE/LIKELIHOOD.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED/WIDELY SCATTERED HIGH-BASED TSTMS SHOULD AGAIN INITIALLY DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF CO/WY AND DEVELOP INTO THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...WITH DOWNBURSTS/LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE POSSIBLE. IT IS CONCEIVABLE THAT A SEMI-SUSTAINED CLUSTER/MCS COULD EVOLVE DURING THE EVENING HOURS ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS...POTENTIALLY INCLUDING PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST NEB/WESTERN KS. THIS REGION WILL BE REEVALUATED FOR A SLIGHT RISK IN SUBSEQUENT DAY 1 OUTLOOKS.

sections.title: LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY/INTERIOR SOUTHERN CA
sections.text: AS A HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AIRMASS PERSISTS ACROSS THE REGION TODAY...DAYTIME HEATING AND ASCENT TIED TO A PERSISTENT/WEAK MID-LEVEL DISTURBANCE WILL LIKELY LEAD TO AN AFTERNOON/EVENING UPSWING IN TSTMS ACROSS THE REGION. SOME OF THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE MICROBURSTS. ..GUYER/SMITH.. 07/31/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY PERSIST ACROSS SW AL THIS MORNING. ALTHOUGH THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED...A WW CAN NOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BOWING LINE SEGMENT CURRENTLY IN SCNTRL AL IS LOCATED ON THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING SWD ACROSS THE WRN FL PANHANDLE AND MOBILE VICINITY. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1500 TO 2500 J/KG RANGE WHICH SHOULD HELP MAINTAIN THE LINE. IN ADDITION...A 30 TO 40 KT LOW-LEVEL IS ANALYZED JUST BEHIND THE LINE AND THIS MAY BE HELPING TO ORGANIZE THE LINE. AS THE LINE MOVES SWD AND LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES STEEPEN SOME OVER THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS...THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY PERSIST. IF AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY OCCURS AS THE LINE MOVES ACROSS SRN AL...THEN A WW MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA FROM SWRN AL...WRN FL PANHANDLE AND FAR SERN MS IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL INCREASE IN TSTM COVERAGE/ INTENSITY EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. IF RADAR TRENDS INDICATE THIS TREND...THEN A WW WOULD NEED TO BE CONSIDERED FOR SWRN AL...FAR WRN FL PANHANDLE AND SERN MS. DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATE MORNING ANALYSIS OF SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/SURFACE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM SWRN GA WWD THROUGH THE NRN EXTENT OF THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. THIS BOUNDARY THEN EXTENDED NWWD IN CONJUNCTION WITH A WARM FRONT THROUGH EAST CENTRAL TO NWRN MS. MEANWHILE...SUSTAINED ROBUST TSTM ACTIVITY WAS MOVING SWD INTO SWRN AL PER 7 KM/9 KM CAPPI DATA AND COOLING CLOUD TOPS ON IR IMAGERY. THESE STORMS WERE LOCATED ON THE SWRN FLANK OF A LARGE MCS LOCATED OVER CENTRAL/SRN AL. WNWLY LOW LEVEL WINDS EXTENDING FROM CENTRAL/SRN MS INTO THE MCS ARE MAINTAINING A FEED OF STRONG INSTABILITY /MLCAPE UP TO 2500 J PER KG/ AND STRONG LOW LEVEL WAA. THESE FACTORS COMBINED WITH 20-30 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR SUGGEST TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE MCS WITH AT LEAST SOME POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZATION. FURTHER SURFACE HEATING WILL STEEPEN LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND COMBINED WITH A RATHER MOIST AIR MASS /PW VALUES AROUND 2 INCH/ SHOULD PROMOTE A THREAT FOR WET MICROBURSTS. THUS FAR...TSTM COVERAGE HAS NOT INCREASED. THIS SUGGESTS THE CURRENT ENVIRONMENT REMAINS MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DEVELOPMENT. GIVEN A LIMITED SPATIAL EXTENT FOR STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS...A WW WOULD NOT BE WARRANTED...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SVR TSTM WATCH IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR PARTS OF ERN IL AND WRN IND. TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS ERN IL INTO WRN/SWRN IND INVOF A COLD FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTION AND SEWD ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATE MORNING SURFACE ANALYSES SHOWED A COLD FRONT ADVANCING SSEWD THROUGH SERN LOWER MI AND THE MIDWEST...WHILE A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM AN EARLY MORNING SRN GREAT LAKES MCS INTERSECTED THE COLD FRONT IN NORTH CENTRAL IL /INVOF LIVINGSTON AND MCLEAN COUNTIES/. THIS OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THEN ARCED SEWD THROUGH SERN IL TO FAR SRN IND AND THEN NEWD THROUGH FAR N CENTRAL KY TO SRN AND ERN OH. REGIONAL RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA INDICATED A TSTM HAD FORMED BETWEEN 1640-17Z ALONG THE BORDER OF NERN MCLEAN AND LIVINGSTON COUNTIES...WHILE A NEW CONVECTIVE UPDRAFT WAS FORMING IMMEDIATELY UPSTREAM AS THE INITIAL STORM MOVED SEWD. STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND COOL MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES /AROUND -10 C PER 12Z SOUNDING ANALYSIS/ WERE RESULTING IN MODERATE-STRONG DESTABILIZATION WITH MLCAPE UP TO 2000 J/KG THUS FAR. ADDITIONAL SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG THE COLD FRONT/ OUTFLOW INTERSECTION AS THE FRONT ADVANCES SSEWD THIS AFTERNOON. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-45 KT ACROSS THIS REGION COMBINED WITH THE STRONG INSTABILITY AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL PROMOTE THE POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE STORMS WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL THE PRIMARY THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASING COVERAGE OF TSTMS OVER THE FRONT RANGE WILL EVENTUALLY SPREAD EWD TOWARDS THE HIGH PLAINS OF CNTRL AND ERN CO. AN ACCOMPANYING THREAT FOR DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL MAY MATERIALIZE. A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY BEING CONSIDERED...BUT MAY BE NECESSARY IF TRENDS INCREASE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL MCV NOTED ON VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY WAS PASSING THROUGH THE FRONT RANGE...POSITIONED W OF FCL AS OF 1930Z...AND IS CONTRIBUTING TO TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE FRONT RANGE THIS AFTERNOON. ONE SUCH STRONG STORM WAS MOVING EWD ACROSS THE DENVER METRO AREA. MODERATE MIDLEVEL WLY FLOW ALONG THE NRN PERIPHERY OF A SRN PLAINS ANTICYCLONE WILL SUPPORT SOME ORGANIZATION OF TSTMS INTO SMALL CLUSTERS. BUT BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE IS SOMEWHAT MARGINAL ACROSS THE HIGH PLAINS N/E OF DEN...WHERE DEWPOINTS HAVE MIXED INTO THE UPPER 40S...LIKELY ONLY YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 500 J/KG. NONETHELESS...STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS...WHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE MARGINALLY SUPPORTIVE FOR HAIL. FARTHER S...TSTMS GENERALLY REMAIN ANCHORED TO THE HIGHER TERRAIN...BUT SHOULD EVENTUALLY PROPAGATE EWD ONTO THE HIGH PLAINS. SFC OBS REVEAL RICHER MOISTURE IS IN PLACE HERE /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 50S/...AND SUBSEQUENTLY...YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1000 J/KG. HOWEVER...WEAKER DEEP-LAYER FLOW MAY RESULT IN STORMS STRUGGLING TO ORGANIZE...ALTHOUGH A COUPLE CLUSTERS COULD EVENTUALLY DEVELOP DUE TO TSTM MERGERS/CONSOLIDATION AND POSE A LOCALIZED DMGG WIND THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE IS INCREASING ACROSS THE WHITE MTNS AND CO PLATEAU OF NERN AZ THIS AFTERNOON...WITH A FEW OF THESE STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AND STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS. DUE TO THE MARGINAL/ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WW IS NOT CURRENTLY BEING CONSIDERED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS INCREASED ACROSS NERN AZ THIS AFTERNOON...PARTLY AIDED BY A MCV POSITIONED E OF PHX AND MOVING N TOWARDS THE MOGOLLON RIM. SEVERAL OF THESE STORMS HAVE OCCASIONALLY DISPLAYED THE POTENTIAL FOR AT LEAST SMALL HAIL. MODERATELY STRONG MIDLEVEL SLY FLOW ALONG THE WRN PERIPHERY OF A SRN PLAINS ANTICYCLONE...SAMPLED AT 20-30 KTS BY FSX VWP...IS SUFFICIENT FOR AT LEAST MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION...LIKELY ENHANCING THE POTENTIAL FOR HAIL. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR FOR A MORE ROBUST SVR THREAT APPEARS TO BE WEAK INSTABILITY ACROSS THE AREA...DESPITE ADEQUATE BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE...PRIMARILY OWING TO WARM MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES AND WEAK LAPSE RATES. A LOCALIZED STRONG WIND THREAT COULD ALSO ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST CONVECTIVE CORES WHERE STRONG HEATING AND DEEP BOUNDARY LAYER MIXING HAS OCCURRED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG THE COLD FRONT AS IT ADVANCES SSEWD THROUGH EAST CENTRAL IL AND WEST CENTRAL IND LATE THIS AFTERNOON...WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS FORMING ALONG THE RETREATING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN SWRN IND. HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS. COUNTIES ACROSS THE FAR NWRN EXTENT OF THIS WW COULD BE CANCELLED EARLY...WHILE LOCAL AREAL EXTENSION OF THIS WATCH MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS CENTRAL IND AS THE AIR MASS DESTABILIZES EWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY SUGGEST THE NRN EXTENT FOR NEW TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS SHIFTED A LITTLE SSEWD FROM MCLEAN COUNTY IL TO BENTON COUNTY IND. IF THIS TREND PERSISTS...THEN THE COUNTIES IN THE NWRN EXTENT OF THIS WATCH COULD BE LOCALLY CANCELLED EARLY. OTHERWISE...ADDITIONAL SURFACE HEATING HAS ALLOWED TEMPERATURES TO REACH THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 100 F IN EAST CENTRAL- SERN IL TO THE IL/IND BORDER. THIS HEATING HAS OCCURRED TO THE WEST OF AN OLD OUTFLOW BOUNDARY THAT HAS BEEN RETREATING NEWD DURING THE LAST FEW HOURS AND AT 2015Z EXTENDED FROM SRN FORD COUNTY IL TO LAWRENCE COUNTY IND. MLCAPE OF 2000-2500 J/KG ACROSS MUCH OF THE WATCH AND DESTABILIZATION WITH EWD EXTENT OVER CENTRAL IND COMBINED WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-45 KT WILL SUPPORT MULTICELL AND SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT YET THIS AFTERNOON. IN ADDITION TO A HAIL THREAT...THE STRONG SURFACE HEATING HAS FURTHER STEEPENED LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITH TEMPERATURE/DEWPOINT SPREADS OF 30-35 DEGREES ENHANCING THE THREAT FOR STRONGER WIND GUSTS. THIS POTENTIAL IS FURTHER SUPPORTED BY DCAPE VALUES THAT ARE AROUND 1500 J/KG FROM CENTRAL/SRN IND TO ERN IL. ..PETERS.. 07/31/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SVR TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED FOR LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EARLY EVENING ACROSS FAR SRN IND INTO ADJACENT COUNTIES OF NWRN KY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SINCE 20Z...A CLUSTER OF TSTMS HAS INCREASED IN INTENSITY ACROSS SWRN IND /SRN CLAY...SRN OWEN AND GREENE COUNTIES/ PER RAPID CLOUD TOP COOLING ON IR IMAGERY AND AN INCREASE IN LIGHTNING STRIKES. THESE STORMS ARE TRACKING SEWD AT 15-20 KT AND WILL EXIT WW 543 BETWEEN 22-23Z INTO FAR SRN IND. THE AIR MASS SOUTH OF THIS WATCH HAS ALSO BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE /1500-2000 J PER KG/ WITH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 30-40 KT SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS WITH SWD EXTENT. MODELS SUGGEST THE ONGOING ACTIVITY OVER SWRN IND WILL PERSIST INTO SRN IND AND ADJACENT NWRN KY THROUGH 00-03Z BEFORE WEAKENING AS THE AIR MASS STABILIZES WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. THIS WOULD SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL NEED FOR A NEW WW SOUTH OF WW 543.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY PERSIST A COUPLE HOURS BEYOND 00Z ACROSS SRN IND INTO WRN AND NCNTRL KY. HOWEVER...COVERAGE OF SEVERE EVENTS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY SPARSE. A COUPLE OF SEVERE STORMS PERSIST OVER SRN IND...BUT UNLESS TRENDS BEGIN TO INDICATE MORE STORMS WILL INTENSIFY...ANOTHER WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW STORMS PERSIST ALONG AND SOUTH OF A COLD FRONT ACROSS SRN IND. THE STORMS ARE DEVELOPING WITHIN AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF AT LEAST MARGINAL SUPERCELL STRUCTURES. ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE DIURNALLY DRIVEN...AND A GENERAL DEGREASE IS EXPECTED BY 02Z AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO STABILIZE. IN THE MEANTIME...A FEW STORMS WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF PRODUCING ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. ..DIAL.. 07/31/2012
